user.title: Oasis Smart Lights
user.description: How do you sign in to the Oasis app?

menu_options.apple: Sign in with Apple or Google
menu_options.bridge: Import from the Oasis bridge on this network (easiest)

password.title: Sign in to Oasis
password.description: Use the same email address and password as the Oasis app.

apple.title: Sign in with Apple or Google
apple.description:
1. Open this link and sign in:

{apple_url}

(Use {google_url} for Google, or {any_url} to choose on the page.)

2. Your browser will end on an error saying the address is invalid, because the final address belongs to the Oasis phone app. That means it worked.

3. Copy that whole address, starting with rainmaker://, and paste it below.

token.title: Use an existing Oasis session
token.description: Paste the refresh token from a session that already works. Use this when signing in fresh keeps being refused even though your credentials are correct.

bridge.title: Import from the Oasis bridge
bridge.description: The address below was filled in automatically. Select Submit and Home Assistant will collect the sign-in for you.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Oasis service. Please try again.
error.no_code: That address has no sign-in code in it. Copy the whole address, starting with rainmaker://.
error.sign_in_refused: Oasis refused the sign-in. Please start the sign-in link again.

abort.already_configured: This Oasis account is already set up.
